entities.name: Lalabalavu Sukuna

entities.summary: Ratu Sir Josefa Lalabalavu Vanayaliyali Sukuna was a Fijian chief, scholar, soldier, and statesman. He is regarded as the forerunner of the post-independence leadership of Fiji.
